entries.title: Hosea 10:1
segments: ¶Israel empties [his] vine; He brings forth fruit for himself. According to the multitude of his fruit He has increased the altars; According to the bounty of his land They have embellished [his] sacred pillars.

entries.title: Hosea 10:2
segments: Their heart is divided; Now they are held guilty. He will break down their altars; He will ruin their sacred pillars.

entries.title: Hosea 10:3
segments: For now they say, "We have no king, Because we did not fear the LORD. And as for a king, what would he do for us?"

entries.title: Hosea 10:4
segments: They have spoken words, Swearing falsely in making a covenant. Thus judgment springs up like hemlock in the furrows of the field.

entries.title: Hosea 10:5
segments: The inhabitants of Samaria fear Because of the calf of Beth Aven. For its people mourn for it, And its priests shriek for it-Because its glory has departed from it.

entries.title: Hosea 10:6
segments: [The idol] also shall be carried to Assyria [As] a present for King Jareb. Ephraim shall receive shame, And Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

entries.title: Hosea 10:7
segments: [As for] Samaria, her king is cut off Like a twig on the water.

entries.title: Hosea 10:8
segments: Also the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, Shall be destroyed. The thorn and thistle shall grow on their altars; They shall say to the mountains, "Cover us!" And to the hills, "Fall on us!"

entries.title: Hosea 10:9
segments: ¶"O Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah; There they stood. The battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity Did not overtake them.

entries.title: Hosea 10:10
segments: When [it is] My desire, I will chasten them. Peoples shall be gathered against them When I bind them for their two transgressions.

entries.title: Hosea 10:11
segments: Ephraim [is] a trained heifer That loves to thresh [grain]; But I harnessed her fair neck, I will make Ephraim pull [a plow]. Judah shall plow; Jacob shall break his clods."

entries.title: Hosea 10:12
segments: Sow for yourselves righteousness; Reap in mercy; Break up your fallow ground, For [it is] time to seek the LORD, Till He comes and rains righteousness on you.

entries.title: Hosea 10:13
segments: You have plowed wickedness; You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, Because you trusted in your own way, In the multitude of your mighty men.

entries.title: Hosea 10:14
segments: Therefore tumult shall arise among your people, And all your fortresses shall be plundered As Shalman plundered Beth Arbel in the day of battle-A mother dashed in pieces upon [her] children.

entries.title: Hosea 10:15
segments: Thus it shall be done to you, O Bethel, Because of your great wickedness. At dawn the king of Israel Shall be cut off utterly.
